_status: DRAFT v0.1 — starter question sets for Interview 2 (Scenario Review, lifecycle step 10). The M&M method lists these sets as 'to build' (assignment D3); review with the Tech Lead before first client use and record changes here.
_answer_types: text | yesno (Yes/No/Maybe) | list:<a>|<b>|<c> | date | person (Name - email)
_columns: kind = approve (pre-filled from systems, owner confirms) or ask (only the interviewee can answer)

OS Modernization.audience: Technical Workload Owner; vendor where certified

questions.question: Current operating system and edition
questions.help: Pre-filled from inventory / Azure Migrate. Confirm edition and patch level.

questions.question: Target operating system version
questions.help: Must be supported by the application vendor and the cloud platform.

questions.question: Upgrade approach
questions.answer: list:In-place upgrade|New VM and reinstall|Vendor appliance replacement
questions.help: New VM and reinstall is preferred where installers and configuration are available.

questions.question: Is the application certified by the vendor on the target OS?
questions.help: Attach the vendor statement or support matrix link.

questions.question: Are installation media, licence keys and configuration exports available?
questions.help: Needed for the reinstall approach and for rollback.

questions.question: Which runtime prerequisites does the application need (e.g. .NET, Java, VC++ runtimes)?
Must the hostname and/or IP address stay the same?
Local accounts, services, scheduled tasks or certificates to recreate
Test cases and acceptance criteria after the upgrade
Rollback expectation
questions.answer: list:Restore snapshot|Keep old VM for N days|No rollback needed

Fileserver Modernization.audience: Technical Workload Owner; share permission owner

questions.question: Share path, size and file count
Target service and tier
questions.answer: list:Azure Files Standard|Azure Files Premium|Azure NetApp Files|Other
questions.help: Premium / ANF for latency-sensitive or high-IOPS workloads.

questions.question: Identity-based access method
questions.answer: list:AD DS|Microsoft Entra Kerberos|Microsoft Entra Domain Services|Storage key (not recommended)

questions.question: Who owns share and NTFS permissions?
questions.help: Approves the ACL check after sync.

questions.question: Consumers of the share (applications, mapped drives, GPOs, scripts)
questions.help: Pre-filled from dependency data; owner confirms.

questions.question: How will clients be pointed to the new location?
questions.answer: list:DFS namespace target swap|GPO drive mapping|Application configuration|DNS alias
questions.help: DFS swap gives the least client impact.

questions.question: Synchronisation method and acceptable final-delta window
Known issues with open files, file locking or long paths?
questions.help: Common with CAD, Office or database files on shares.

questions.question: Required snapshot / backup retention
questions.help: Maps to Azure Backup for Files policy.

questions.question: Can all clients reach the private endpoint on SMB port 445?

Database Modernization.audience: DBA (Technical Workload Owner if no DBA)

questions.question: Engine, version and edition
Databases, sizes and growth
Target service and tier
questions.answer: list:Azure SQL Managed Instance|Azure SQL Database|Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible|Azure Database for MySQL flexible|SQL Server on Azure VM (fallback)
questions.help: Proposed by the System Engineer from the assessment.

questions.question: Features in use that may block PaaS (SQL Agent jobs, CLR, linked servers, cross-database queries, SSIS/SSRS, FILESTREAM, Service Broker)
Does the application vendor support the target service?
Authentication model after migration
Who changes connection strings / aliases, and how many places?
Migration method and tolerated downtime
High availability / disaster recovery requirement
questions.answer: list:None beyond service default|Zone redundancy|Failover group (cross-region)

questions.question: Backup retention and long-term retention requirement
Preferred platform maintenance window
questions.help: Maps to the service maintenance configuration.

questions.question: Selected SaaS product / vendor and contract status
questions.help: Signed, in negotiation, or not selected.

questions.question: Number of licences / users and licence model
Which data must be migrated (scope, volume, history) and in which format?
questions.help: Define what stays in the archive.

questions.question: Data residency and regulatory requirements
questions.help: Check vendor hosting region and certifications.

questions.question: Single sign-on and user provisioning
questions.answer: list:Entra ID SSO (SAML/OIDC) + SCIM|SSO only|Local accounts

questions.question: Interfaces to rebuild (systems, direction, frequency, owner)
Vendor SLA and support model
questions.help: Feeds rows 7, 8 and 14 of the operations manual.

questions.question: Coexistence and cutover approach
questions.answer: list:Big bang|Phased by user group|Parallel run

questions.question: Archive and retention of legacy data; when can the old servers be decommissioned?
questions.help: Required before Decommission cards can be worked.

questions.question: Exit strategy / data export option from the vendor

Application Runtime Modernization.audience: Developer or vendor; Technical Workload Owner

questions.question: Technology stack and versions (language, framework, web server)
Who owns and can change the source code?
questions.help: No access to source usually means Rehost now.

questions.question: Target runtime
Does the application keep session state or write to the local disk?
Where are configuration and secrets kept today?
Source repository and CI/CD pipeline
Dependencies (databases, queues, file shares, external APIs)
User and service authentication model
Scaling and performance targets
Monitoring and logging expectations
Test strategy (automated / manual) and test owner
Release and rollback approach

VDI Modernization.audience: Workplace / EUC team (not the Workload Owner)

questions.question: Current platform, number of users and peak concurrency
Target service
questions.answer: list:Azure Virtual Desktop pooled|Azure Virtual Desktop personal|Windows 365|Other

questions.question: Full desktops, published applications, or both?
Image and application packaging approach
questions.help: e.g. golden image + MSIX app attach.

questions.question: User profile solution and storage
Printing, USB, scanners or other redirection requirements
Client devices and access paths (internal, remote, MFA, conditional access)
Latency-sensitive back-end applications used from the desktop
questions.help: Back-ends should move close to the host pool.

questions.question: Pilot group and rollout waves
questions.help: Each user wave is its own cutover group.

questions.question: Licensing in place (Windows E3/E5, M365, RDS CAL)
